verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single community comment saying the Milvus vendor pushed 'their Zilliz SaaS'. That implies a managed hosted offering exists, but no first-party docs describe it, and nothing shows programmatic provisioning (API, CLI or IaC). The rest of the pack covers only self-hosted modes (Lite, Standalone, Distributed on Kubernetes). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a fully managed cloud service, programmatic provisioning API/CLI/Terraform, independent hands-on corroboration.
